mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_ID, CONFIG_GROUP, CONFIG_KEY, CONFIG_VALUE, CONFIG_VALUE_ENCRYPTED, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM TB_SYSTEM_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = #{configGroup} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CONFIG_ID
